slides.header: Summer's winding down. Your roof's biggest season starts now.
Fall is the season that counts
slides.body: Whatever condition your roof is in when the rains start is the condition it fights winter in. September and October are your window.
Trim branches overhanging the roof (the single best moss prevention there is) and knock out any repairs you've been putting off while the weather is still friendly.
After the big leaf-and-needle drop, get valleys cleared and gutters flowing. Then check them again after the first real storm.

slides.header: Treat for moss before the wet
slides.body: Moss treatment goes on before the wet season gives spores their opening. Paired with the fall clear-out, it's the most important roof work of the year.
A loose shingle in October is a leak in December. If your roof is borderline this fall, deal with it now rather than betting on a dry January.
